title: Conformance vector
description: One packet, and what it decodes to. Read in both directions.

message.description: Identity of the message this packet carries.

version.description: Client version the packet was taken from. Selects the revision.

bytes.description: The complete channel payload, in hexadecimal. Whitespace is ignored.

fields.description: The decoded value of every field the revision defines. Byte runs are hexadecimal, and an unsigned 64 bit value is a decimal string.
